title: Raccoon reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Raccoon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#8B7D6B'/>
  <!-- Raccoon head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#9E8E7A'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='34' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#7A6E5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='34' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#7A6E5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='34' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#D4A9A0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='34' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#D4A9A0'/>
  <!-- Face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='15' ry='9' fill='#4A3F4E'/>
  <!-- Eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='47' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#3D3342'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='47' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#3D3342'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#F5F0DC'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#F5F0DC'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='2' fill='#2A2233'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='47' r='2' fill='#2A2233'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#2A2233'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#C4B8A8'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M47 58 Q50 61 53 58' stroke='#5A4E4A' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='55' r='3' fill='#D4A9A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='55' r='3' fill='#D4A9A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Stripes on head -->
  <rect x='47' y='32' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7A6E5C'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g>
    <!-- Book cover left -->
    <path d='M28 72 L50 68 L50 88 L28 92 Z' fill='#E85D5D'/>
    <!-- Book cover right -->
    <path d='M50 68 L72 72 L72 92 L50 88 Z' fill='#D44A4A'/>
    <!-- Book pages left -->
    <path d='M30 73 L49 69 L49 86 L30 90 Z' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <!-- Book pages right -->
    <path d='M51 69 L70 73 L70 90 L51 86 Z' fill='#F5ECD7'/>
    <!-- Book spine -->
    <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#B03A3A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- Text lines on left page -->
    <line x1='33' y1='76' x2='46' y2='74' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='79' x2='46' y2='77' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='82' x2='46' y2='80' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='85' x2='44' y2='83' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Text lines on right page -->
    <line x1='54' y1='74' x2='67' y2='76' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='77' x2='67' y2='79' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='80' x2='67' y2='82' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='83' x2='65' y2='85' stroke='#A09880' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='78' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#7A6E5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='78' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#7A6E5C'/>
  <!-- Paw fingers -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='76' r='1.2' fill='#8B7D6B'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='75' r='1.2' fill='#8B7D6B'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='76' r='1.2' fill='#8B7D6B'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='76' r='1.2' fill='#8B7D6B'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='75' r='1.2' fill='#8B7D6B'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='76' r='1.2' fill='#8B7D6B'/>
</svg>
